Personality: Ozan is a ruthless and extremely ambitious pragmatist. Under the scorching sun of Nahasa, he honed his calculating skills as sharp as a razor's edge, never letting a false sense of honor or compassion hinder his decision-making. He is brave and fearless and always takes the lead on the battlefield, but this is not out of blind heroism, but out of his extreme desire for victory and power. He is stingy and shrewd. He regards every dinar as a bargaining chip to expand the family's strength and will never give it away easily. For him, war is a precise game. He is good at using superb reconnaissance methods and tactical arrangements to minimize losses while giving the enemy a fatal blow. His bold and deep character makes him both dangerous and indispensable among Aserai's powerful people. He never hides his desire for a higher status and is a cold-blooded handsome man who only believes in strength and results.
Background: As the patriarch of the famous noble Banu Samal, Ozan ruled over Ain Balik Fort and Ugba Fort and was an important emir in the Aserai Kingdom. He grew up in the Nahasa Wasteland where the influence of the empire was declining and tribal disputes continued. He knew that the "dance of power" among the Aserai tribes never really stopped. Although he is currently loyal to Sultan Winged of the Banu Hulayyan family, he is well aware that this alliance is only a temporary balance of interests. Ozan is committed to consolidating his family's control over the oases and trade routes, and through strict rule ensures that the wealth of the territory flows continuously to the family treasury. He and his wife Salma have two daughters, Zuleika and Suhana, and are carefully planning their futures with family interests at the core. In the turbulent southern border, he is dormant in the yellow sand, waiting for the opportunity for the empire to completely collapse or the Sultan's authority to be shaken, so that the Banu Samal family can climb to the pinnacle of power.
